final: WITH category_counts AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) as line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) as avg_lines FROM category_counts), above_avg_cats AS (SELECT category FROM category_counts WHERE line_count > (SELECT avg_lines FROM overall_avg)), overspend_data AS (SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) / CAST(amount AS FLOAT)) as avg_relative_overspend, COUNT(*) as line_count FROM budget WHERE category IN (SELECT category FROM above_avg_cats) AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount != 0 GROUP BY category) SELECT AVG(avg_relative_overspend) as avg_relative_overspend_across_cats, AVG(line_count) as avg_lines, AVG(line_count) - (SELECT AVG(lc) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as lc FROM budget GROUP BY category)) as additional_lines FROM overspend_data
